summary: Iter21 Document Insights bug-fix backend testing complete. All 41 iter19+iter20+iter21 unit tests pass in-process (5 new TestInsightsFalsePositiveGuards cases included). Added a live-smoke suite that hits the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL end-to-end (register → upload → GET /insights) and verified the deterministic label-aware extractor over ingress: 4/4 live tests pass. Phones no longer capture TktID/order numbers/timestamps/11-digit sequences; tax_ids only accept strict 16-char Italian CF or label-prefixed 11-digit P.IVA; 11-digit bare sequences are correctly demoted to numbers only; order_ids bucket populated correctly for TktID/Numero ordine/A-2026-0009. Full-suite regression across ALL backend tests shows pre-existing Motor 'event loop is closed' infra errors (documented in conftest.py) when unrelated modules run in the same process — NOT caused by iter21 (individual re-runs pass).

minor.issue: Pre-existing test infra issue: modules defining their own module-scoped TestClient hit 'Event loop is closed' when full suite runs together (Motor + TestClient lifespan). Documented in /app/backend/tests/conftest.py. Not caused by Iter21. Recommend migrating remaining modules to use `shared_client` fixture.

critical_code_review_comments: insights.py extract_entities is well-structured with span reservation; priority order (emails→urls→iban→amounts→dates→times→tax_ids→phones→order_ids→numbers) is defensible.
_PIVA_LABELED_RE correctly enforces label prefix and (?!\d) tail-guard.
_ORDER_LABELED_RE captures full match span (including label) via m.span(0), which is critical for correctly preventing lower-priority patterns from re-consuming the numeric tail.
insights.py is ~500 LOC — under the 700 threshold; no split required.
build_structured_summary correctly prefers order_ids[0] over numbers[0] for ticket & invoice branches.
No LLM/OCR re-run on insights path — confirmed via test_i6 (duration_ms and extracted_at stable across calls).
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Test users registered per-run with TS-prefixed emails (iter21_<ts>_<uuid>@ora.app). Test documents uploaded per user and left in place (isolated per-user).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 'event loop is closed' errors seen when running the ENTIRE /app/backend/tests/ directory together are a well-known Motor + TestClient issue documented in /app/backend/tests/conftest.py — NOT bugs. They only occur when multiple modules define their own module-scoped TestClient fixture. Individual modules and small groups (like iter19+iter20+iter21) run cleanly. Prefer running scoped subsets or using the `shared_client` session fixture. Live smoke against ingress works via EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) as the ORA app defines it in /app/frontend/.env.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: phone/tax_id extractors used loose numeric-run regexes that matched TktID, order numbers, Unix timestamps, and any 11-digit sequence. Fix (verified): rewrote extract_entities as a priority pipeline with character-span reservation — self-anchored patterns (emails/urls/iban) claim spans first, then amounts/dates/times, then tax_ids (strict 16-char CF alfanumerico OR label-prefixed 11-digit P.IVA), then phones (label OR intl + OR IT mobile 3XX+6-7digits), then labelled order/ticket IDs, then generic long numbers on unclaimed spans only. Since each pattern claims m.span(0) (the FULL match including its label), lower-priority patterns cannot re-consume the digits. Verified end-to-end via 5 new guard tests + 4 live smoke tests over ingress.
